Trajectory-recording k-means with a simple interface

Source: R/kmeans.R
kmeans_fun.Rd

Convenience wrapper around kmeans_with_trajectory() that runs k-means with k clusters and returns the full trajectory object. This is the clustering function expected by selective_hotelling_test() and the MCMC samplers (because it returns init_centers_idx, enabling loop-safe fixed-init re-clustering).

Usage

kmeans_fun(x, k = 3)

Arguments

x

A numeric data matrix with observations in rows.

k

Number of clusters.

Value

The list returned by kmeans_with_trajectory() (with cluster, trajectory, init_centers_idx, etc.).

Examples

set.seed(1)
X <- generate_exchangeable_null_data(30, 2, rho = 0.1)$dat
km <- kmeans_fun(X, k = 3)
table(km$cluster)
#> 
#>  1  2  3 
#> 12 14  4
